result.note: Tests the new partnership label and the concrete defence-industrial and innovation outcomes of the February 2026 Modi–Macron meeting.

questions.prompt: In February 2026, India and France upgraded their bilateral relationship to which of the following?
questions.explain: Prime Minister Modi and President Macron upgraded ties to a Special Global Strategic Partnership on 17 February 2026. The label puts France on par with India's top-tier relationships with Japan and the US.
questions.source: Prime Minister Modi and President Macron upgraded bilateral ties to a "Special Global Strategic Partnership" on Tuesday, moving beyond just trade to co-manufacturing everything from Everest-bound helicopters to AI health tech.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the outcomes of the India–France summit held in February 2026:
items: An Airbus H125 helicopter assembly line was inaugurated in Karnataka.
A BEL-Safran joint venture was approved to manufacture HAMMER precision-guided missiles in India.
The India-France Year of Innovation 2026 was launched with a focus on AI in health and digital science.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements match the story. The H125 is an Everest-capable helicopter that both sides are targeting for export, and a Swami Vivekananda Cultural Centre will also open in France.
questions.source: The duo inaugurated an Airbus H125 helicopter – the Everest-capable helicopter that both sides are targeting for export – assembly line in Karnataka and greenlit a BEL-Safran joint venture to manufacture HAMMER precision-guided missiles in India.
